name: Mossback Quarry
description: An old quarry swallowed by the forest, its terraces green with moss and the copper stain still bright beneath it.

discovery.message: Through the trees you see cut stone terraces: an old quarry, gone green.

face.text: The forest has nearly taken the quarry back, but where the moss is scraped away the rock is stained bright with copper.

leave.text: You shoulder your pack and leave the seam behind.
